scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, compelling headline, subheadline, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Open the application at the root URL '/'
Check that product name, headline, and subheadline are visible and properly styled
Confirm primary 'Get Started' and secondary 'Login' buttons are present and visible
steps.context: Buttons should use FuturisticButton component styling

steps.description: Confirm BackgroundEffect component is rendered in the hero section
steps.context: Visual effect should be visible without obstructing content

test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 heading with product value proposition
Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' or 'Create Free Account' is present
Secondary CTA button/link with text 'Login' is present
BackgroundEffect component is rendered in the DOM
Subheadline text is visible below the main headline

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays 3-4 feature cards using GlassMorphismCard components with proper icons, titles, and descriptions

steps.description: Open the application at the root URL '/'
Navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Confirm 3-4 feature cards are displayed with URL Shortening, Click Analytics, Dashboard, and Share Stats features
steps.context: Each card should use GlassMorphismCard component

steps.description: Each card should have an icon, title, and description
steps.context: Content should clearly explain each feature

test_cases.expected: Features section contains at least 3 GlassMorphismCard components
URL Shortening feature card is present with appropriate title and description
Click Analytics feature card is present with appropriate title and description
Dashboard feature card is present with appropriate title and description
Each feature card contains an icon element

scenarios.name: Navigation CTA Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify call-to-action buttons navigate to correct pages (login and register)

steps.description: Open the application at the root URL '/'
Click the 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' button
Confirm user is navigated to /register page
Navigate back to homepage
Click the 'Login' button/link
Confirm user is navigated to /login page

test_cases.input: Click primary CTA button (Get Started/Sign Up)
test_cases.expected: Navigation to /register route is triggered
Navigation to /login route is triggered
Button has correct href='/register' or onClick handler that navigates to /register
Element has correct href='/login' or onClick handler that navigates to /login

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify homepage displays correctly on mobile viewports (width < 768px) with proper layout adjustments

steps.description: Resize browser or set viewport to mobile size (375px width)
Open the application at the root URL '/'
Confirm hero content stacks vertically and is readable
steps.context: No horizontal scrolling should be needed

steps.description: Confirm feature cards stack vertically on mobile
steps.context: Cards should be full width on mobile

steps.description: Confirm CTA buttons meet minimum touch target size (44px)

test_cases.expected: No horizontal overflow/scrollbar is present
All content is readable without zooming
CTA buttons have minimum height and width of 44px for touch accessibility
Feature cards are displayed in single column layout

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Verify homepage displays correctly on tablet viewports (768px - 1024px)

steps.description: Resize browser or set viewport to tablet size (768px width)
Open the application at the root URL '/'
Confirm layout adjusts appropriately for tablet viewport
Confirm hero, features, and footer sections are all accessible
steps.context: All content should be properly sized

test_cases.expected: Layout adapts to tablet-appropriate sizing
Feature cards may display in 2-column grid
No content overflow or clipping occurs

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators

steps.description: Open the application at the root URL '/'
Press Tab key to navigate through interactive elements
steps.context: Focus should move in logical order

steps.description: Confirm each focused element has a visible focus indicator
steps.context: Users must see which element is focused

steps.description: Press Enter/Space on focused buttons to activate them
steps.context: All buttons should be keyboard activatable

test_cases.expected: All CTA buttons receive focus in logical order
Visible focus ring/outline is displayed

test_cases.input: Press Enter on focused CTA button
test_cases.expected: Button action is triggered (navigation occurs)
No positive tabindex values that break natural tab order

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Semantic HTML Structure
scenarios.description: Verify proper semantic HTML structure with correct heading hierarchy and ARIA labels

steps.description: Open the application at the root URL '/'
Confirm headings follow logical order (h1 -> h2 -> h3)
Confirm use of semantic elements (main, section, nav, footer)
Confirm interactive elements have appropriate aria-labels where needed

test_cases.expected: Exactly one h1 element exists on the page
Heading elements follow proper hierarchy without skipping levels
Main content area uses <main> element
Footer uses <footer> element
Icon-only buttons have aria-label attributes

scenarios.name: Public Access Without Authentication
scenarios.description: Verify homepage is accessible without authentication and does not redirect to login

steps.description: Ensure no authentication token exists in localStorage
Open the application at the root URL '/'
Confirm homepage content is displayed without redirect
Confirm no authentication error messages are displayed

test_cases.expected: Homepage renders without redirect to /login
No authentication error messages displayed
Homepage route '/' is not wrapped in ProtectedLayout
